newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens to build Mexico phone network.
newsitem.headline: Siemens to build Mexico phone network.

text.p: Siemens AG said on Friday that it had signed a turnkey contract to build a 110 million mark long-distance telephone network in Mexico for network operator Marcatel.

The Siemens Public Communications Network Group will install the fibre-optic network, and Marcatel will start operations on a 1,300 km link between Mexico City, Guadalajara and Monterrey at the start of next year.

Marcatel is a consortium grouping Mexican service provider Radio Beep, with a 51 percent share, and two U.S. long-distance operators Westel and IXC with a combined share of 49 percent, Siemens said in a statement.
